objectives.text: Explain how chlorophyll captures light energy and why that matters for glucose production.
objectives.success_criteria: Exit ticket paragraph names chlorophyll, light energy and glucose.

objectives.text: Describe the reactants and products of photosynthesis using the word equation.
objectives.success_criteria: Completed word equation with reactants and products in the correct order.

objectives.text: Explain why photosynthesis is essential for life on Earth.
objectives.success_criteria: Short answer links photosynthesis to food chains and oxygen.

formative: Teacher observation of the chlorophyll reveal discussion.
Exit ticket paragraph checked against the chlorophyll success criterion.
assessment.summative: Teacher-reviewed exit ticket and a short explanation of the word equation.
success_criteria: Links photosynthesis to food chains and oxygen.

conclusion.summary: Close with a one-minute partner summary and a quick vocabulary check.
next_steps: Review exit-ticket evidence before the next lesson.
Re-teach gas exchange for students who need it.
conclusion.exit_prompt: Why is photosynthesis essential for life on Earth?

note: Clarified the first objective, tightened the assessment criteria and added an exit prompt.
